about: Malachi is the last book of the Old Testament. It calls people to give God their best and waits for the Savior.

pages.title: Give God Your Best
pages.scene: A family bringing their best gifts to the temple
pages.text: People were giving God their worst animals. Malachi said, "Give God your best!" God promised, "Bring your gifts, and see if I won't open the windows of heaven and pour out blessings!"

pages.title: The Sun Will Rise
pages.scene: Happy calves jumping in the sunshine
pages.text: Malachi said, "For you who love God, the sun of righteousness will rise with healing in its wings. You will jump for joy like calves let out to play!" God's people waited for the One who would come.
pages.lesson: God's love brings joy and healing.
